title: Expose planning promote CLI
description: Implement wtp planning promote with one or more of the six grouping filters and optional --dry-run. Reject missing selectors, duplicate/blank flags, status flags, task IDs, and extra positionals. Dry-run prints would-promote count plus the exact deterministic planning records and leaves storage byte-identical; the mutating path prints promoted count and resulting todo views. Root --json returns a stable object containing dryRun, count, and items. Surface zero-match and dependency-closure errors without partial output, and ensure promoted IDs immediately fail planning show but succeed task show. Add parser-order, combined-filter, text/JSON, stdout purity, no-op, and end-to-end provider tests.
